text_en: To the leader. Of David. A Psalm. A Song.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官。

text_en: Let God rise up, let his enemies be scattered; let those who hate him flee before him.
text_cn: 愿天主兴起，使他的仇敌四散， 愿仇恨他的人，由他面前逃窜！

text_en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away; as wax melts before the fire, let the wicked perish before God.
text_cn: 愿恶人在天主面前，灭亡消散， 就像烟被风吹蜡被火化一般。

text_en: But let the righteous be joyful; let them exult before God; let them be jubilant with joy.
text_cn: 但义人要在天主面前踊跃欢乐， 他们也必在愉快之中加倍喜悦。

text_en: Sing to God, sing praises to his name; lift up a song to him who rides upon the clouds — his name is the Lord — be exultant before him.
text_cn: 请你们向天主歌唱，咏赞他的圣名； 为那乘车经过旷野者，把道路修平； 他名叫雅威，应在他面前喜气盈盈。

text_en: Father of orphans and protector of widows is God in his holy habitation.
text_cn: 天主常在自己的圣所内居住， 是孤儿的慈父，是寡妇的保护，

text_en: God gives the desolate a home to live in; he leads out the prisoners to prosperity, but the rebellious live in a parched land.
text_cn: 天主给无靠的人备妥房屋， 引被掳的人重获自由； 叛逆者仍在干旱居留。

text_en: O God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness, Selah
text_cn: 天主，当你领导你的百姓出走， 就在你踏入旷野的时候： （休止）

text_en: the earth quaked, the heavens poured down rain at the presence of God, the God of Sinai, at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
text_cn: 大地在天主面前震动，高天也滴下细雨， 西乃在天主，以色列天主前也颤栗不休。

text_en: Rain in abundance, O God, you showered abroad; you restored your heritage when it languished;
text_cn: 天主，你给你的产业降下甘霖， 因而复苏了疲倦的人民。

text_en: your flock found a dwelling in it; in your goodness, O God, you provided for the needy.
text_cn: 于是，你的羊群便在那里安住， 天主，以你的慈爱照顾了贫苦。

text_en: The Lord gives the command; great is the company of those who bore the tidings:
text_cn: 当上主一发出了断语， 妇女便结队前来报喜：

text_en: “The kings of the armies, they flee, they flee! ” The women at home divide the spoil,
text_cn: “领兵的君王已经逃走远遁， 家中的闺秀分得了战利品。

text_en: though they stay among the sheepfolds— the wings of a dove covered with silver, its pinions with green gold.
text_cn: 正当你们在羊栈中寻梦， 鸽子的翅翼涂上了白银， 翎毛闪烁着火红的黄金，

text_en: When the Almighty scattered kings there, snow fell on Zalmon.
text_cn: 当全能者驱逐列王的时间， 飘飘的雪花落向匝耳孟山。”

text_en: O mighty mountain, mountain of Bashan; O many-peaked mountain, mountain of Bashan!
text_cn: 巴商山是巍峨的高山， 巴商山是多峰的青山。

text_en: Why do you look with envy, O many-peaked mountain, at the mount that God desired for his abode, where the Lord will reside forever?
text_cn: 多峰的青山，你为何嫉视天主爱住的圣山？ 嫉视上主要永久居住的圣山？

text_en: With mighty chariotry, twice ten thousand, thousands upon thousands, the Lord came from Sinai into the holy place.
text_cn: 天主的车辇盈千累万， 我主由西乃驾临圣殿。

text_en: You ascended the high mount, leading captives in your train and receiving gifts from people, even from those who rebel against the Lord God’s abiding there.
text_cn: 你带领俘虏，升上高天，接受众人作为贡品， 连不愿住在上主天主前的人，也当了贡品。

text_en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears us up; God is our salvation. Selah
text_cn: 唯愿上主天天受赞美！ 他承担了我们的重负， 因他是救我们的天主。 （休止）

text_en: Our God is a God of salvation, and to God , the Lord, belongs escape from death.
text_cn: 我们的天主实在是拯救人的天主， 上主天主使我们摆脱死亡的关口。

text_en: But God will shatter the heads of his enemies, the hairy crown of those who walk in their guilty ways.
text_cn: 天主必要把他敌人的头颅击穿， 必要把固执于恶者的脑袋打烂。

text_en: The Lord said, “I will bring them back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,
text_cn: 我主说：“纵使他们逃至巴商，我也要把他们捉回来， 纵使他们躲在海底，我也要把他们逮回来，

text_en: so that you may bathe your feet in blood, so that the tongues of your dogs may have their share from the foe. ”
text_cn: 为使你在鲜血中洗涤你的脚， 你的狗以舌头舔食敌人的血。”

text_en: Your solemn processions are seen, O God, the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary—
text_cn: 天主，人都看见你的御辇， 看见我主我王，光临圣殿：

text_en: the singers in front, the musicians last, between them girls playing tambourines:
text_cn: 歌咏的人在前，奏乐的人在后， 在中间还有一队鸣鼓的少女。

text_en: “Bless God in the great congregation, the Lord , O you who are of Israel’s fountain! ”
text_cn: “你们应在盛会中赞美天主， 以色列的子孙应赞美上主。”

text_en: There is Benjamin, the least of them, in the lead, the princes of Judah in a body, the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
text_cn: 最幼小的本雅明领导在前， 随后有犹大的首领和随员， 则步隆和纳斐塔里的长官。

text_en: Summon your might, O God; show your strength, O God, as you have done for us before.
text_cn: 天主，求你显示出你的威能， 天主，显出为我们行的大能。

text_en: Because of your temple at Jerusalem kings bear gifts to you.
text_cn: 为了你在耶路撒冷的圣殿， 众君王必要向你奉上祭献，

text_en: Rebuke the wild animals that live among the reeds, the herd of bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot those who lust after tribute; scatter the peoples who delight in war.
text_cn: 恳求你怒叱芦苇中的野兽， 成群的公牛和列国的牛犊； 愿他们带着银块前来降服， 愿你驱散喜爱战争的民族！

text_en: Let bronze be brought from Egypt; let Ethiopia hasten to stretch out its hands to God.
text_cn: 愿有使臣由埃及来就， 雇士向天主高举双手！

text_en: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord, Selah
text_cn: 普世万邦，请歌颂天主，也请赞扬上主。 （休止）

text_en: O rider in the heavens, the ancient heavens; listen, he sends out his voice, his mighty voice.
text_cn: 他自永远就是驾御高天穹苍的大主， 听！他的声音发出，巨大的声音已发出。

text_en: Ascribe power to God, whose majesty is over Israel; and whose power is in the skies.
text_cn: “你们应承认天主的大能！” 他的荣耀光照以色列人， 他的神威已发现在天云。

text_en: Awesome is God in his sanctuary, the God of Israel; he gives power and strength to his people. Blessed be God!
text_cn: 天主，以色列的天主，在圣所中显得可敬可畏， 他曾将力量和权能赐于百姓。愿天主受赞美！
